about: Single content model for the four recovery design diagrams. Stable node ids are the shared deep-link vocabulary for the GUI (Pipeline Map, pipeline breadcrumb): each id is a <g id> in its SVG, a UserObject id in its .drawio file and an <a id> anchor in its .outline.md file. Generators own layout and palette; this file owns every content string. Design artifacts only; no product, game or binary names.

conventions.node: Every node has id, diagram, kind, family and title; nested nodes also name their semantic parent (used for breadcrumbs). Text arrays are drawn one element per line.
conventions.how_lines: In stage and lane-card 'how' arrays, a line that starts with two spaces continues the previous bullet.
conventions.try_lines: 'try' arrays and milestone 'body'/'proof' arrays are one wrapped paragraph.
conventions.nested_ids: Lane cards (lane-X-card-N) and ladder members (ladder-X-N) carry their own ids inside their parent node and are deep-link targets too.
conventions.ladder_members: slug is the locator kind the diagram shows in brackets (null when none is shown); label is present only when the bracket text differs from the slug.
conventions.stage_gate: A stage's gate_id names its gate node (null for stage 2, which has no gate).
conventions.edges: drawn=true marks an arrow that appears in the diagram. Labelled drawn edges carry an id (also a <g id> and outline anchor), the drawn label, a spoken form for the outline, and 'follows', the id after which the edge is read. A drawn edge that was first read from diagram text keeps inference='stated' and its quoted 'basis'; only edges whose text states them directly are drawn.
conventions.inferred_edges: Every edge that is not a drawn arrow has inferred=true and a 'basis' quoting the diagram text it was read from. inference='stated' means that text says it directly; inference='interpretation' means it is a reading of the text that needs review.
conventions.catalog_verbs: catalog_verbs is keyed by catalog verb and names the stage, lane and export node ids the verb serves. It is filled only from the consolidated design plan §2.1 (docs/dashboard-design/2026-09-21-consolidated-design-plan.md): its stage table maps verbs to stages 1–7, and its 'Verbs outside stages 1–7' decision maps export verbs to export nodes ('exports', with a 'label' the stage chip shows instead of the node title, so a v1 pack never reads as v2). 'quote' is that table cell; 'status' is the plan's word for a verb not yet in the catalog. Stage 0 is the workbench's open, add and resume, never a job verb; stage 8 has no verb; no verb maps to a lane by name. The live catalog (GET /api/v1/actions) is the verb authority: a future check, not run, compares this map with a catalog snapshot, and a verb missing on either side renders 'stage: unmapped'. The per-node verb lists in the outlines are derived from this map.
conventions.crosswalks: Each crosswalks entry reads one lifecycle state as the design step it instantiates (TaskLifecycle state to an execution step, FailureRecord lifecycle state to a resilience step). Every entry is inference='interpretation': 'basis' quotes docs/plans/2026-09-22-task-acceptance-and-continuation-design.md and 'matches' quotes the step text it was matched to. Crosswalks are design readings, never the runtime's state machine. lifecycle_states lists every state and where its name comes from; a state without an entry has no supporting text and stays unmapped.

edge_types.depends_on: `from` requires `to` first; drawn as a solid arrow from `to` to `from`.
edge_types.feedback: `from` returns evidence to the earlier `to`; drawn dashed (4 4) with a ↺ label.
edge_types.failover: `from` retries through bounded fallbacks without blocking siblings; drawn dashed (6 4).
edge_types.gates: `from` must pass before `to` may claim its result.
edge_types.consumes: `from` reads outputs or evidence produced by `to`; when drawn, an arrow from `to` into `from`.
edge_types.serialized_by: mutations by `from` take the one-owner lock `to`.

roles.bytes: BYTES, recovered source, resume, implemented foundation (role-bytes)
roles.acceptance: independent acceptance; creative and playback milestones (role-acceptance)
roles.gate: gate-like question, CONTINUE, POLICY, qualification and feasibility (role-gate)
roles.contain: FENCE, QUARANTINE, CONTROL PLANE, DATA/PROVIDER, locks and failover (role-contain)
roles.note: neutral header, section, note or worked example

agentdecompile-recovery-pipeline.title: AgentDecompile — the recovery pipeline, end to end
agentdecompile-recovery-pipeline.desc: Reading order: header and key, then the main pipeline left to right from stage 0 (open, add or resume) through stage 8 (whole-image byte identity), then concurrent lanes A–E, bounded resolution ladders A–F, ownership locks, the failover rule, the export target and the full legend. Solid arrows are prerequisites, dashed arrows are failover or labelled feedback, and every gate must pass before its claim is accepted. Candidates, compiled code, local parity zeros, runtime calls and original bytes never count as recovered source or whole-image proof; only whole-file hash equality is terminal. Design only: future checks are not run; agentdecompile-recovery-pipeline.outline.md is the text outline with the same node ids.

execution-contracts.title: Execution and evidence contracts
execution-contracts.desc: Reading order: three task steps (declare, admit, compute outside the commit), three independent binding proofs (bytes, identity, operation), independent acceptance feeding separate original-code and recovered-source capabilities, then fence, quarantine and continue, and the late-worker design challenge. Missing evidence blocks only its own claim, an unhealthy resource blocks its dependents, and ready independent work continues. Design specification only: the late-worker experiment and all future software acceptance checks are NOT RUN; execution-contracts.outline.md is the text outline.

resilience-contracts.title: Prevention, containment and recovery
resilience-contracts.desc: Reading order: six lifecycle steps (prevent, detect and classify; record the decision; repair, reroute or wait; accept against the current basis; resume only the justified capability; prevent recurrence), then the control-plane, data/provider and policy/canary containment boundaries and a worked interruption. Every recovery action returns through independent acceptance, and an available process is not a repaired capability. Design only: failure-injection checks are NOT RUN; resilience-contracts.outline.md is the text outline.

autonomous-capabilities.title: Autonomous capability delivery: current foundation and future milestones
autonomous-capabilities.desc: Reading order: six workflow steps from request to continuation, the reconciliation banner, milestones M0 to M7, the first complete product demonstration and the human-input boundary. One existing task authority connects evidence, admission, isolated operations, independent acceptance and continuation. M0 has implemented foundations and partial software verification; M1 through M7 are future capabilities and the first demonstration is NOT RUN; autonomous-capabilities.outline.md is the text outline.

nodes.title: AgentDecompile — the recovery pipeline, end to end
nodes.subtitle: Reading order: named stages retain prerequisites; evidence feeds back and verification starts early. Every card answers: what we're trying to do · how · what goes in and comes out · what gates it.
nodes.design_target: Design target: recover from the best evidence, reuse only what transfers, verify at the level of use — packs, generated bindings, headers and readiness reports with explicit capability limits.
nodes.scale_note: Runs on a laptop; scales by concurrency, then by donated idle compute and free cloud nodes; task-specific budgets and isolated storage probes; complete prepared inputs enable independent continuation; see execution-contracts companion.

nodes.title: HOW TO READ THIS IN 20 SECONDS
items: 1. Follow prerequisites; identity/calibration iterate and parity runs continuously.
2. Lanes may overlap within ownership, resource and snapshot-dependency limits.
3. Try applicable lookups; exports state capabilities, uncertainty and evidence.
nodes.key: Key: solid arrow = dependency · dashed red arrow = failover · ↺ feedback = dashed arrow back to an earlier stage · G diamond = gate · padlock = one owner · uppercase header word = family · full legend at the bottom.

nodes.title: MAIN PIPELINE — compatible reuse · validated reconstruction · independent claim gates
nodes.subtitle: 0 + eight named stages · feedback allowed · reuse valid unchanged receipts

nodes.title: Open · add · resume (priority-zero)
try: Start from the actual project, never a setup ritual:
open, add or resume admits only missing eligible work;
pause/resume controls admission — no Start ritual.
how: reconcile bindings; reuse dependency-valid receipts
gate writes; reads use stable versioned snapshots
the one control is pause/resume (+ scope), never start
checkpoint-trusting; repair only on detected breakage:
NULL content_sha256 / mixed basis_hash → receipted
backfill, never auto-run
revisit affected evidence only; no blanket reanalysis
reopen reuses valid work; changed evidence re-keys work
io: out: one active project, known state, no duplicate work

nodes.title: Identity
try: Decide which functions/entities across builds are
logical entity, implementation variant and instance;
similarity does not prove interchangeable behavior.
how: extract facts once; short-circuit identical images
cheap-first cascade: symbols/provenance → exact &
reloc-normalized hashes → rare refs / C++ meta →
neighborhood → CFG/SPP → BSim → ABI → optional
BinDiff/BinExport → optional emulation on residue
require uniqueness + margin; keep ambiguity;
withdraw bad seeds + unsupported descendants
io: in: analyzed programs, debug info, formats
out: entity / variant / instance + evidence lineage

nodes.title: Incremental calibration
try: Establish minimum platform facts, then refine
compiler, ABI and layout hypotheses with
identity and function evidence; version each input.
how: compiler/linker + headers/libs + macros + FP mode
scope: build / library / TU / function overrides
group fragments into TUs/LTCG as required
probe legacy switches; record scoped dependencies
io: out: calibration record (part of the basis)

nodes.title: Validated linkable regions
try: Reconstruct objects and placement from the image;
keep uncertain boundaries in larger regions;
prove reconstruction before scaling source work.
how: bytes + fixups + refs + data + unwind metadata
architecture-specific objects / external assembly
extract → emit → place → compare original bytes
then prove a compiled replacement actually contributes
io: out: validated region scaffold; floor ≠ recovered C

nodes.title: C/C++ candidates
try: Produce readable candidates; preserve the floor
until replacement acceptance passes.
how: recovery unit ≠ compilation unit ≠ comparison unit
compile pass → candidate (real_c is compile-only)
fail → deterministic helpers (sanitizer/preparse) →
retry → ONE bounded LLM cleanup → retry → keep asm
never repeat valid unchanged work
repair explains preserved machine behavior
io: out: compiled candidates + scoped compile receipts
nodes.tag: isolated mutable outputs / PDB / Wine state

nodes.title: Propagation (cross-place)
try: Reuse a donor candidate only for compatible
recipient implementation variants;
each recipient earns its own acceptance.
how: compile + variant/ABI/layout compatibility gate
then byte-exact verify → permuter → LLM last
a logical_id bind alone NEVER authorizes copying
ABI-sensitive types re-validated per recipient
field-level knowledge fusion runs alongside (lane A)

nodes.title: Targeted AI (leftovers only)
try: Spend model effort ONLY on what deterministic
methods left behind — leaves before callers.
how: residue queue, tagged with WHY AI was needed
diagnose behavior/types → ABI → context → codegen
LLM output is a candidate — never a trusted edge
ReAgent checker; record exact proposals + bounds
io: out: candidate C for review + provenance

nodes.title: Continuous parity
try: Compare emitted code/data against validated
targets and independently against linked bytes.
how: objdiff local + linked-region checks (LTCG aware)
reccmp: supported MSVC / PDB diagnostics
compile / ABI / tested behavior / local / linked
a function-level zero is NOT whole-image proof
io: in: emitted regions + validated original references
out: separate facts with mapping, bounds + evidence

nodes.title: local zero ≠ full-image or behavior proof
Whole-image byte identity
try: The terminal goal: relink into a file whose
whole-file hash EQUALS the shipped binary.
how: early stage-3 round trips; fresh terminal compilation
reproduce section order, padding, headers, IAT, relocs
prove replacement use → whole-file byte/hash check
two variants measured separately: byte-accurate+floor
vs max-C; never borrow a receipt between them
reconstruction ≠ original-style rebuild; record method
io: in: scoped parity + contribution map + layout recipe
out: rebuilt image + whole-file hash receipt

nodes.title: RUNS CONCURRENTLY WITH STAGES 1–8 (where ownership permits)
Knowledge fusion — bidirectional, per field
nodes.subtitle: labels · comments · structs/types · debug-info names flow between every build sharing a logical id; strongest source per field wins; a build donates a FIELD, never everything
nodes.connects: consumes stage 1 identity · runs beside stages 4–5 · feeds every sibling build

cards.title: Name precedence (per field)
try: Keep the strongest name for every field,
never let a placeholder win.
how: human annotation → debug info / STABS →
authentic symbols → analysis names → placeholders
provenance + rejected alternatives retained

cards.title: Types & layouts
try: Merge struct/type knowledge only where
compatibility gates allow.
how: types/layouts keep their own gates (never auto-copied)
platform-gated donors: (arch, bits, endian, compiler)
per-build layouts; unknown spans opaque; no scaling

cards.title: Comments · bookmarks · evidence
try: Nothing authored is lost; conflicts stay visible.
how: per-field precedence merge, never wholesale
conflicts and human edits preserved
receipt per merged field

cards.title: Runs alongside recovery
try: Fusion never waits for source recovery
and never blocks it.
how: overlaps when transactions don't collide
serialized only at the shared corpus mutation point
resource-aware admission (measured memory/swap)

outputs: merged names / types / comments PER FIELD, each with origin and rejected alternatives
consumed by stage 5 placement (type-compatibility gate) and by the ABI + struct blocks of the pack
surfaces in the readiness report as which build donated which field
never overwrites a stronger field; conflicts stay visible for review

nodes.title: Cross-build entity unification & export — every entity, not just functions
nodes.subtitle: portable signatures · entity catalog · data-root locator families with fallbacks · divergence · codecaves · ABI — feeds the runtime pack
nodes.connects: consumes stages 1–2 (+ raw images) · feeds lane C and the export bundle

cards.title: Portable signatures (identity ≠ locator)
try: Discover supported entities across related builds;
record absent, ambiguous and unsupported outcomes.
how: identity evidence cascade ≠ runtime locator search
runtime LOCATOR family: reloc-masked window →
anchor-relative (import/export/string) → verify hash
corpus-computed uniqueness + margin shipped in pack
library/CRT excluded; identical bodies → anchors
io: in: raw image + decode + reloc table

cards.title: Entity catalog
try: Everything a mod could want, unified:
how: functions · patch points · immediates · call sites
globals · singletons · structs & fields · vtables · RTTI
strings · tables · enums · imports/exports · dispatch
TLS · unwind · sections · resources · integrity checks
io: out: entities[] with kind, shape, locators

cards.title: Data-root locator families
try: Known build: identity → RVA → live check.
Unknown build: applicable discovery + refusal.
how: symbol → xref-from-identified-function → anchor-rel
→ masked adjacency → pointer chain → vtable/RTTI
known-build RVA is preferred; portable:false
resolver: verify · memoize per build hash · report
member · REFUSE, never zero

cards.title: Divergence (3-way, never forced)
try: When the surrounding logic is too different,
SAY so and SHOW it — never fake a match.
how: CFG delta + neighborhood symmetric difference
integer components, rational thresholds (no floats)
1↔1 · split-or-inlined · diverged
review lane shows why; nothing propagates silently

cards.title: Codecaves & ABI (Lua-ready)
try: Export what injection needs, portable:
caves as plan templates, ABI as data.
how: cave = anchor-sig + offset + capacity REQUIREMENT +
relocation rules + originals + restoration + claim
ABI: convention · this-kind · per-arg storage · sret
allocation policy + lifetime checks; refusal supported
io: out: caves[] + abi blocks in pack v2

cards.title: Generic core · adapters
try: No product ever in the core.
how: L1 core: any PE/ELF/Mach-O/XBE — masks, CFG, caves
L2 arch adapter: detour width, relocs, reach
L3 engine adapter + build profile: script API, this-kind
names live in external data packs only
pack.json + sha256 in the basis; missing pack →
missing_adapter, never a default

outputs: logical_signature per entity + per-build coverage · entities[] catalog (30 kinds, pack enum)
data-root recipes with ordered fallbacks · divergence class per pair · caves[] + ABI blocks
all of it lands in hookpack v2 → consumed by lane C (runtime) and the export bundle
generic core + adapters: a new engine adds an L3 data pack, never core code

nodes.title: Runtime reuse & learn-the-build — branches after identity/ABI evidence, before whole-image recovery
nodes.subtitle: calling original code never counts as recovered source; observations feed back as evidence with provenance
nodes.connects: branches after stages 1–2 evidence · consumes lane B's pack · feeds evidence back into stage 1

cards.title: Pack → resolve
try: Verify build identity and live evidence before
authorizing each requested runtime operation.
how: try members in order; verify each; memoize by image hash
known: recorded RVA first → expected live bytes
unknown: bounded discovery; report uncertainty

cards.title: Preflight → controlled call/install
try: Never write into a process blind.
how: capacity + originals + page protection checked live
tested install/remove + safe trampoline reclamation
ABI / object lifetime / thread / policy / owner checked
byte journal rollback ≠ undo of executed side effects

cards.title: Observe → evidence
try: Turn runtime behavior into corpus evidence.
how: traces: calls, args, returns, field changes
provenance-bearing; refines names/types/behavior
never promotes source parity

cards.title: Learn the build
try: Each new build contributes provisional evidence;
contradictions may lower accepted coverage.
how: export per-member resolution results as a build report
corpus ingests runtime_claim rows — never identity;
bind_identities promotes or rejects (receipt + delete)
residue re-attacked offline (BSim, emulation)

outputs: resolved sites per build + WHICH ladder member resolved each (feeds coverage + readiness)
observations → runtime_claim + observed_status; promotion only through bind_identities
build reports → provisional claims → independent acceptance or named unresolved outcomes
never promotes source parity; never counts original bytes as recovered C

nodes.title: Verification & determinism — same inputs → byte-identical outputs, under a declared basis
nodes.subtitle: replay recorded proposals and observations under a versioned basis; discovery itself need not be deterministic
nodes.connects: wraps every stage and lane · gates every export

cards.title: Determinism basis
try: Make 'same result' meaningful.
how: decoder/analyzer revision + option set + cspec id
algorithm / masking / threshold versions
toolchain identity per build; filler set; seeds
data-pack hashes; per-binary basis_hash
refuse on unknown / empty / mixed basis
corpus hash only for corpus-dependent work
io: out: basis object in every pack

cards.title: Two gates
try: Prove reproducibility, don't assume it.
how: export byte-diff: export twice → identical bytes
cascade harness: three layouts (canonical · shuffled
rows + shuffled binary order · + VACUUM/ANALYZE)
+ key-stability run → identity, match (incl. id),
logical_function, recovery_family equal as sorted row-sets

cards.title: Ordering discipline
try: No hidden order can reach a persisted value.
how: every SELECT feeding a decision has a total ORDER BY
every 'best/first' pick has a total tie-break
sets/dicts sorted before hashing or serializing
floats rounded before persistence

cards.title: Receipts & re-baseline
try: Change the basis deliberately, never silently.
how: receipts hash relevant dependencies + snapshot
changed input → invalidate affected descendants
acceptance rejects stale versions; old packs readable

outputs: the basis object stamped into every pack, header, report and receipt
two pass/fail gates in CI: export byte-diff and the cascade harness
content-addressed receipts → identical-basis re-runs are cache hits
basis change → deliberate re-baseline with a recorded supersession, never silent drift

cards.title: Objects & logs
try: Working state supports independent replicas:
content-addressed, log-structured, network-capable.
how: sha256 objects, write-once (If-None-Match / atomic rename)
per-partition append-only logs of signed, chained records
heads = one CAS pointer per partition; rebuilt by chain scan
adapters: local · S3-compatible · static mirror · peer HTTP
compaction: signed checkpoints; peers prune below them
io: out: immutable objects + verifiable partition chains

cards.title: Tasks & frontier
try: Jobs bounded and addressable; resume where inputs exist;
result exists ≠ independently accepted claim.
how: task_id = sha256(kind, version, inputs, params, basis projection)
frontier from log; admission checks live resources separately
expired lease fences publication; uncertain resources quarantine
persistent input-scoped retry budget; deadline ≠ termination
a basis field change re-keys only the kinds that consume it
io: out: offered tasks · result objects · timeout records

cards.title: Join (one command)
try: Any machine, one verb: laptop, donated idle box,
free cloud node, browser tab.
how: attach-first: find the running local agent, never a second start
canaries prove capability: python · parity · toolchain · analyzer
capability decides lanes and fetches — a role never does
roles decide only mirrors + who signs invites / verifies / applies
outbound HTTPS only; no inbound port; --idle-only, --cores N
io: in: invite URL + what the node can prove
out: lanes offered by canary; inputs fetched by task

cards.title: Verify (every result a proposal)
try: Trust the hash, never the key — fleet nodes included.
how: acceptance requires independent evidence roots, not just keys
recompute or hash-lookup; byte-exact = recompile + parity
no quorum, no credit, no reputation; a liar wastes ≤ 4 verifies
donated .obj / .bin never evidence (byte-emitter refuted)
verification ordered before generation (no livelock)

cards.title: Views (SQLite as a materialized view)
try: The corpus store and the similarity index are replays of
verified records: deletable, rebuildable, never locked by work.
how: one applier per view; bounded transactions; ack after commit
identity / logical / match / knowledge / receipts from deltas
view-stale is a named state with an age (H11), never a stall
no worker ever opens a view for writing (H1 by construction)
adgrid view materialize rebuilds from record 1
io: out: grid_* tables · similarity index · receipts

cards.title: Fleet (free cloud nodes)
try: The operator never depends on volunteers: rented
free-tier nodes join with the same command in cloud-init.
how: adgrid fleet up / down / status / replace; manifest as objects
providers: manual · ssh · declared cloud adapters
lane placement by canary, never by tier or role
host failover needs independent replica + capable worker
host loss: continue only with complete surviving input closure
io: in: provider credentials via the secret path; an invite
out: nodes that joined; fleet manifest objects

outputs: one package (CLI adgrid) reusable for any CPU/IO-heavy work; the pipeline's lanes are adapters over it
planned grid contracts; implementation status belongs to delivery evidence, not this design diagram
every stage runs as grid tasks: compile / parity / decompile / cascade / export lanes, each a proposal
timeouts record attempt outcomes, not termination; resource release requires evidence; independent acceptance only

Are these bytes here?

rows: Exact target digest + image/address mapping
Observed region and independent byte comparison

Does not establish the selected function name

Donor labels remain hypotheses until accepted

Located / readable / callable / detourable / writable

Independent acceptance, short commit
rows: Verifier checks exact claimed level and raw evidence
Check input versions AND current generation
Commit manifest + ledger; no artifact IO here
Task complete only when required predicates pass

nodes.label: 5A
rows: Original implementation may remain assembly floor

Scenario: build + fixture + driver + postconditions

Validated fixups + metadata + unchanged round trip
Compile ≠ local match ≠ linked match ≠ full equality

nodes.title: Separate outputs, never an implied readiness ladder
Reject obsolete publication
nodes.label: FENCE
rows: Old generation or changed inputs → historical only
Keep artifact; refuse current acceptance/promotion
Re-key only affected dependency descendants
Collision discovery may reduce accepted coverage
Fencing does NOT prove a worker has stopped
Representation totals disjoint; capabilities overlap

nodes.title: Keep resources occupied
nodes.label: QUARANTINE
rows: Expired lease / timeout ≠ safe resource release
Late or kernel-blocked worker may still access state
Release needs corroborated end of access + owner
Atomic local locks; PID identity alone is insufficient
Private replacement only on disjoint safe resources
Bound isolated storage probes; never block scheduler

nodes.title: Only ready independent work
nodes.label: CONTINUE
rows: Transient failure: one owner, bounded durable retry
Deterministic negative: changed hypothesis required
Provider circuit break; split task or compatible route
No ready work: persist dependency sets + wake event
Complete remote replica + worker needed for host loss
New user message does not reset retry budget

Future proof: inject this race and inspect accepted-generation receipts, ownership events and B’s dependency manifest.

nodes.tagline: One durable decision owner. Recover the affected dependency; retain the objective, evidence and independent work.

nodes.title: Prevent, detect, classify
rows: Fixture recheck after ownership, before mutation
Observe process tree, unit receipts and goal facts
Classify: mismatch / transient / resource / policy
Distinguish missing evidence from unhealthy resource
Unknown outcome stays unknown until reconciled
No health decision from one noisy sample alone
Capture exact input, policy and observation versions

nodes.title: Record the decision before effects
rows: Pure reducer: frozen facts + policy → next action
Atomically reserve attempt budget + effect intent
One durable retry budget; no nested retry owners
Persist reason, scope, wake predicate + event cursor
Deterministic negative requires changed hypothesis
New user message does not reset attempt spending
Ledger unavailable → pause new managed mutations

nodes.title: Repair, reroute or wait
rows: Repair only classified prerequisites with evidence
Reroute only to declared compatible capabilities
Checkpoint/split within the unchanged claim scope
Reconcile cursor + exact version/owner/provider wake
Unknown non-idempotent effect: inspect, never replay
Quarantine resources until end of access is proven
Independent work continues only if fully supplied

nodes.title: Every recovery action returns through independent acceptance; an available process is not a repaired capability.
Accept against the current basis
rows: Inspect new artifact and claim-specific proof roots
Recheck dependencies, generation and policy version
Prepare durable artifact outside acceptance commit
Short commit: manifest reference + corpus receipt
Required task predicates determine completion
Failure retains useful units without promoting claim
Resource release is separate from acceptance

nodes.title: Resume only the justified capability
rows: Revalidate affected descendants, preserve others
Clear quarantine only on resource-release evidence
Expire old runtime preflight and reacquire live facts
Record liveness / unit progress / accepted progress
No ready work → durable wait, no repeated audit loop
Expose exact reason and next eligible wake condition
Unknown empirical results remain explicitly unknown

nodes.title: Prevent recurrence without blind tuning
rows: Aggregate failure signatures by input/policy basis
Propose narrow policy change with deciding metric
Canary uses frozen baseline and bounded population
Independent reviewer accepts evidence, not opinion
Regression → restore prior admission policy version
Preserve failure history; never reset spent budgets
Roll back policy, not arbitrary already-run effects

nodes.title: Fail read-only
nodes.label: CONTROL PLANE
rows: Lost durable decision or acceptance authority:
pause new managed mutation/admission in that scope
Keep cached read-only evidence available with age
Old outputs stay private/quarantined until reconciled
Do not kill external owners or assume children stop
Reconcile owner/generation and durable log on return
Unknown command outcome → inspect before retry
Wake: healthy durable authority + reconciled state

nodes.title: Isolate dependency
nodes.label: DATA / PROVIDER
rows: Bound storage probes outside coordinator loop
One recovery probe per provider + shared retry budget
Complete input closure required for alternate worker
Partial copies never become launchable manifests
Tmpfs is budgeted cache, not durable rescue default
Host loss needs independent replica AND worker
Retry requires budget + safe resources + current basis
Wake: new verified inputs / capability / released owner

nodes.title: Bound the change
nodes.label: POLICY / CANARY
rows: Policy is immutable versioned data; producer cannot edit
Canary declares baseline, population and abort rule
Compare acceptance errors, useful throughput and cost
No broader rollout from a successful process exit
Revert routing/admission version if metric regresses
Reassess active attempts under their recorded policy
Accept only with pinned/current policy compatibility
Wake: accepted policy version or corrected evidence

nodes.title: Worked interruption · the command was sent, then the decision store disappeared
lines: Observe: command ID C may have changed the game; the connection closed before its result was durably recorded.
Contain: pause new managed mutations in this scope; preserve read-only status and existing evidence; do not replay C.
Recover: reconcile C against observed engine state and ownership. Resume only after durable authority and state agree.
Future proof: inject disconnect; show no blind duplicate dispatch, retained unknown outcome, reconciliation and scoped resumption.
If the effect cannot be determined, keep the affected operation waiting and expose the exact required observation.
nodes.status: NOT RUN · design acceptance is artifact consistency; runtime recovery needs the future measurements specified in the plan.

nodes.title: Autonomous capability delivery
nodes.subtitle: Desired capability + exact eligible game/build → supported operation + understandable proof
nodes.tagline: One task/acceptance authority • reuse preparation, corpus receipts, recovery supervision and runtime adapters

rows: Behavior, target, predicates
Allowed effects and cost

nodes.title: Resolve evidence
rows: Reuse valid receipts
Name missing prerequisites

nodes.title: Deterministic admit
rows: Pinned observations + policy
Ownership and budget gates

nodes.title: Isolated action
rows: Typed catalog operation
Qualified engine adapter

nodes.title: Accept independently
rows: Observe required behavior
Retain scoped proof

nodes.title: Continue
rows: Reuse accepted observations
Exact wake; no blind replay

nodes.title: Unknown effects → reconcile; unavailable authority → pause new mutations; unrelated eligible work → keep progressing.
Useful native capabilities first; platform and browser investigations can proceed independently.

proof: no routine user repair of paths,

nodes.title: Operation bundle
body: Share help, CLI, Lua and harness.

nodes.title: Creative projects
body: Reopen in a fresh game session.

nodes.title: Native host matrix
proof: Windows proof does not qualify Mac.

nodes.title: First complete product demonstration — FUTURE / NOT RUN
lines: One requested native capability: discovery → binding → UI or Lua → prepared scenario,
independent state observation → verified supported restoration → useful recorded clip.
Behavior, capture integrity and presentation are separate acceptance predicates.
A job result, syntax pass, browser shell or Wasm utility does not prove this delivery.
Source parity, native game behavior and platform qualification keep separate receipts.

nodes.title: Human input only for genuine exceptions
lines: legal, credential or device access; required external
Local artifact creation ≠ external publication authority.
